reasons.open_why: Open shelf unit is not stated, so it will be omitted.
reasons.storage_why: Storage will be provided by the base units, wall cabinets, and tall units.
reasons.features_why: No special feature units are required.
reasons.wall_cabinets_why: Wall cabinets will be used to fill the free run of the secondary wall (Wall 2).
reasons.wall_style_why: Hinged shutters will be used for the plain wall cabinets.
reasons.finish_why: PU fronts will be used for both the base run and the wall run.
reasons.loft_why: Lofts will be added above the wall units and tall units to provide additional storage space.
